author: Russell Brand
description:
What's really behind the dramatic rise in autism diagnoses? Russell Brand and his guest discuss the reported prevalence of autism among American children, question how much of the increase can be explained by changes in diagnosis, and revisit a 2009 UC Davis study examining possible contributing factors. Could environmental influences be part of the picture, and how much do we actually know about why autism diagnoses have increased?

author: Russell Brand
description:
Today I’m joined once again by Greg Pai, author of Voice of the Heart: The Battle for Your Purpose, Peace and Passion. We talk about how technology, media and modern systems increasingly separate us from God, one another and our own sense of purpose; why suffering can become part of spiritual transformation; and Greg’s idea of “extraction” — the layers of noise, distraction and dependency that pull us further from truth. We also explore what a more grounded Christian response might look like: stronger communities, greater self-reliance and lives built around faith rather than the values of the world.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Are you really in control of your mind, or are your cravings controlling you? Russell Brand explores how constant entertainment, endless scrolling, and everyday habits can trap us in cycles of addiction, drawing on the Apostle Paul's teaching about renewing the mind through Christ. From reaching for another Oreo to the strange relief of taking off painfully tight shoes, Russell and his guest reveal how we can become addicted to escaping discomfort we keep creating for ourselves — and why true freedom begins with breaking that cycle.
